summary.text: Ice mirror snow lotus is a rank six immortal material that holds ice path and wood path dao marks.

claims.text: On a steep mountain peak in the Bai Xiang ice and snow region of a public grotto-heaven, a hundred ice mirror snow lotuses grow. Ice mirror snow lotus is a rank six immortal material containing ice path and wood path dao marks. Snow monsters, including desolate level snow monsters, guard the lotuses and stop anyone who tries to take them. Along the same route, ice mirror snow lotus is also named among small to mid sized resource points with plentiful storage, together with hundred years profound ice, thousand years profound ice, mystical frost water, and heaven craft divine jade.

The same list of resource points, including ice mirror snow lotus, appears again when the grotto-heaven is described as opening only once a hundred years and thus accumulating many resources in closely packed small and mid sized points.

Origin.text: Mountain peak in Bai Xiang grotto-heaven territory
